ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), is made as of Street Brooklyn, NY 11249 (hereinafter referred to as “Owner"), and Arlind Org LLC, having an address at 66North 8th Street Brooklyn,NY 11249 (hereinafter referred to as"Developer")(Owner and Developer are sometimes hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee title of that certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, County of Kings, known as Lot 17 in Block 2292 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the “Tax Map"), and known as and by the street address 623 Union Avenue, Brooklyn, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (said land being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Land"; the buildings and improvements on Owner's Land, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Building"; and Owner's Land and Owner's Building, collectively, being hereinafter referred to as “Owner's Property"); WHEREAS,Developer is the owner in fee title of that certain parcel of land, with any buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, County of Kings, known as Lot 18 in Block 2292 on the Tax Map, and known as and by the street address 621 Union Avenue, Brooklyn, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being referred to herein as “Developer's Land'"; and the building and improvements thereon or under construction thereon, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as “Developer's Building"; and Developer's Land and Developer's Building, collectively, being hereinafter referred to as “Developer's Property"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct a new or enlarged building (the “New Building") upon all or a portion of the Developer's Land; WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more floor area ("Floor Area"), as defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15, 1961, as amended (the “Zoning Resolution"), than is now available for use on the Developer's Property with the result that Developer desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining the Developer's Land and Owner's Land into a single zoning lot (the "Combined Zoning Lot") for the purpose of determining compliance by the New Building with the ZoningResolution; WHEREAS, there are Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) that are or may become appurtenant to Owner's Land; that are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) currently utilized by Owner's Building (the “Retained Development Rights"); WHEREAS, the Parties acknowledge and agree that the Owner's Retained Development Rights and existing building envelope of Owner's Building, including its existing Floor

Area Development Rights, footprint, and height, shall not be increased from what is existing on the datehereof,whichamountof FloorAreaDevelopmentRightsandbuildingenvelopearemore particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part of hereof; and WHEREAS Owner has agreed to sell and Developer has agreed to purchase all of the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined), it being understood that Owner is retaining all right, title, and interest in and to the Retained Development Rights. WHEREAS by execution of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions of even date procedure available under Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to combine the Owner's Land with the Developer's Land so as to create a new, combined zoning lot (such combined zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged or subdivided in accordance with this Agreement, the “Combined Zoning Lot"), for the purpose of making available the Subject Floor Area Development Rights and any Floor Area Development Rights from any Additional Parcels (as hereinafter defined) acquired by Developer for utilization in connection with the construction of a New Developer Building. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and legal sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows: Section 1.1 (a)As used in this Agreement, the term “Floor Area Development Rights”' shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoninglot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by multiplying the area of such zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio (as defined in the Zoning Resolution) for structures in the zoning district in which such zoning lot is located. (b)As used in this Agreement, “Agency” shall mean the New York City Planning Commission, the Department of City Planning of the City of New York, the City Council of the City of New York, the New York City Department of Buildings, the Board of Standards and Appeals of the City of New York, the Landmarks Preservation Commission, the Brooklyn Borough President, or agency of the State of New York or the United States of America or any successor entity to any of the foregoing. ( As used in this Agreement, “Bonus Rights" shall mean (i) any bonus floor area and other development rights attributed to a zoning lot which may be or become available for inclusion in a building constructed thereon through the provision of an amenity or public benefit, either on the Combined Zoning Lot or on a zoning lot that is not included in the Combined Zoning Lot, in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Zoning Resolution, and/or (ii) the further inclusion of any use, bulk, density, and other development.rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution on an as-of-right basis and by special permit, variance, or by any other procedure or transfer allowed under the provisions of the Zoning Resolution, including, without limitation, Sections 34-223,35-35; 74-711;74-79 and 23-90 et seq.thereof, and which may be authorized to be developedbyanAgency. 2
